title: Gravemark brings its loot-losing dungeon crawl to Android
summary: The four depths in Gravemark are named after Dante’s Inferno, which means the bottom floor of a free-to-play hack-and-slash is now Judecca, home of a seasonal leaderboard. Dante would have had something to say. More importantly, after a run of iPhone-first releases, it’s out now on Google Play and nowhere else. Finally, something for Android. Gravemark comes from Tokyo hammock Inc., in English and Japanese, and it’s built for one-handed portrait. Your attacks happen on their own. You handle skills and potions, and the bigger decisions: which of two paths to take on each floor, and when to stop going down. ... [MORE]

title: Subway Loop brings The Exit 8-style anomaly horror to iPhone
summary: Android owners aren’t having a great day. Subway Loop is the third game I’ve written up today that launched on iPhone first, though this one is out now on iOS and has at least promised Android a seat soon. It’s anomaly horror on a subway train. You ride the same carriage over and over, with the same seats and the same passengers, and at every station you make a call. If anything’s changed, get off. If nothing has, stay on. Get it wrong, and you’re back at the start, or at the last checkpoint on the easier settings. ... [MORE]

title: Accelebot turns your iPhone into a tilt-controlled platformer you can play one-handed
summary: You don’t get a single button in Accelebot. No d-pad, no jump icon parked in the corner, nothing. You tilt your iPhone to move, tap anywhere on the screen to jump, and that’s the whole control scheme, playable one-handed in portrait. It’s a 2D platformer, and it’s out now on the App Store. It comes from solo developer Robert Perez. The levels are large, with secrets tucked away for anyone who goes poking around. The level select screen keeps track of which ones you’ve found. Each level also logs your total time, so you can chase your own best or the developer’s, and there’s a quick menu for switching off the sound effects and music without leaving a level. Wearable cosmetics are in there too. ... [MORE]

title: Foundation: Galactic Frontier celebrates one year since launch with Astral Alignment event
summary: Foundation: Galactic Frontier is a game with which I have a strenuous relationship. Although it's based on a franchise with true pedigree to its name, both the original Isaac Asimov series and its Apple TV adaptation, it's had some truly shockingly dire promotion. But never mind that, because Foundation: Galactic Frontier is reaching at least one major milestone with its first anniversary! To mark a year since launch, the folks at FunPlus are bringing a brand-new anniversary called Astral Alignment to players, which runs from now until November 7th. The anniversary event is set to introduce new crew members, as well as flagship skins and city decorations to really emphasise the sense of occasion, not to mention plenty of festive backdrop elements on the flagship display interface. ... title: Pokémon TCG Pocket announces the debut of Dual-type cards in new Dual Fusion expansion
summary: Most trading card games thrive on predictability, where your knowledge of the game and your opponent's hand is a key strategic strength. For example, in Pokémon, you know certain types are strong against others, like Electric against Water. But Pokémon TCG Pocket is upsetting that paradigm of predictability with the debut of dual-type cards in their upcoming Dual Fusion expansion, which arrives on October 29th! Now, we all know that in Pokémon you have different 'types', be that Fighting, Fire or Metal. And it's the rock-paper-scissors at the centre of these different card types that forms the basis of the game. But dual-type cards boast two instead, and are guaranteed to switch things up in the new Dual Fusion expansion. ... [MORE]

title: Momolitos brings 600 creatures to iOS, with food deciding what they become
summary: Drawing 600 of anything sounds like a lot. Drawing 600 creatures, and then programming the thing they live in, is what Goca, the solo developer behind Goca Games, has done with Momolitos, and I’d like to think there’s a sketchbook somewhere that’s just eyes and tails. Momolitos launches on iOS this week, alongside Switch and Steam, and what you feed your creatures decides what they turn into. You start with an egg, raise whatever hatches, and head out into a handful of colourful worlds looking for ingredients. Bring them back, try a new food, see what happens. Some forms are cute, others apparently go somewhere much stranger. ... [MORE]

title: FingerLaserX is out now, taking you back to a simpler time on mobile with action-packed gameplay
summary: Nowadays, mobile plays to everything from simple, casual puzzlers to sprawling open worlds full of fantasy and adventure. But turn the clock back to 2012, and you'll find a very different scene, full of smaller, quirkier entries. And that is precisely the world that FingerLaserX is a throwback to. FingerLaserX may seem familiar, and that's because it is. First launched back in 2012, this simple neon bullet hell had you sliding your finger to bring down attacking enemy spaceships. Flashy and fast-paced, it proved to be a major hit on mobile and even briefly dethroned YouTube on Taiwan's app store charts during a free promotion. ... [MORE]

title: Eterspire sends you into an abandoned manor to finish a very suspicious experiment
summary: A hooded stranger at a mining camp wants you to go and finish an experiment somebody walked away from in an abandoned manor. Can’t see anything going wrong there. That’s the start of Hazardous Residence, a new level 24 quest coming to indie MMORPG Eterspire in its next update, Secret of the Abandoned Manor.  The quest is built around puzzles, with a horror slant to suit the month. It frames the whole thing as a question of whether you’re brave enough to see the experiment through or just foolish enough to try, and I’d gently point out those two overlap a fair bit. You’ll find the Hooded Person at the Mining Camp when you’re ready to find out. ... [MORE]

title: Champion Tennis is an upcoming quirky little 3D sports sim with one big problem
summary: If you've been looking for a new tennis-based sports sim to play, then you're not exactly spoilt for choice. Football and baseball get plenty of attention, but tennis? Not so much. That is, unless you hop into Champion Tennis, the new game from Mnshine studio, now available to purchase on Google Play, with a free demo on the Chinese platform TapTap! Champion Tennis is a surprisingly quirky arcade tennis sim that has you making your way through individual cups while gathering absurd upgrades. You'll gather skill cards offering various upgrades and moves to help you out, even letting you hurl lightning, ice and meteor shots at your opponent. And with a huge number of cups, AI opponents and other content, it seems almost perfect. ... [MORE]

summary: Hay Day is continuing its suite of recent celebrity collabs that have featured the likes of Gordon Ramsay and Joe Jonas, tying it into the spookiest month of the year. As part of their Halloween event, Hay Day has teamed up with Yvette Fielding, the host of the long-running UK ghost-hunting show Most Haunted. title: Cult Vacui has you racing against time in a tense, terrifying point-and-click adventure
summary: It seems as though nothing good comes of heading to remote Scottish islands. And Cult Vacui is only further evidence of that, as the horror point-and-click adventure, with the constantly ticking clock, arrives on iOS and Android! So step in, get moving and watch the minutes fly by towards true terror. Cult Vacui sees you step back in time to the 19th century, as you arrive on the remote island of Barra in Scotland, to take up your role as new caretaker of the Gladstone summer estate. title: Seolhwa Dungeon turns Korean folktales into deadly roguelike rules
summary: Beetlejuice is summoned only when you take his name three times. Jeoseung Saja, the grim reaper in Seolhwa Dungeon, works the other way round. He calls your name once for every turn he can see you, and on the third call, you’re the one who disappears. That’s a fair taste of how Seolhwa Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike RPG, goes about things. Seolhwa means folktale in Korean, and solo devel Sungki Soft has built the whole dungeon out of them, so the stories aren’t just set dressing. They’re the rules. ... [MORE]

title: Wavy Road is a quirky little endless runner that's launching with its own Halloween event
summary: Endless runners are a constant favourite on mobile, and for good reason. They're easy to pick up, hard to put down, and, depending on the developer, can have all kinds of interesting twists on a simple format. And that's what Wavy Road is setting out to achieve, with its quirky endless runner action coming to iOS on October 21st. Wavy Road stands out because you aren't following a track, but laying it yourself. As you move your vehicle, the road ahead will similarly twist and turn, with the objective being (obviously) to avoid obstacles. As you twist the road, you'll need to watch what your vehicle of choice is doing, and keep it on track for as long as possible. ... [MORE]

title: Torchlight: Infinite introduces the dark depths of Tartarus in SS14, out now
summary: With Halloween right around the corner, we're seeing plenty of popular mobile games getting in on the action with seasonal events. But whereas Play Together went cute and creepy with their Sweet Halloween event, Torchlight: Infinite takes a different route as you dive into the darkest depths of Tartarus. Tartarus is the centrepiece of the new game mode of the same name. In it, you'll venture into the titular dungeon prison, fighting your way through inmates to gather their nameplates before taking control of the prison yourself. After that, you'll pit the various inhabitants against one another, before finally taking on the survivors. ... [MORE]

title: Truck Manager marks 2nd anniversary with over 30 million downloads worldwide
summary: Trophy Games has plenty of reasons to celebrate this month as Truck Manager reaches its second anniversary with over 30 million downloads. Having hit the ground running with over a million pre-registrations before launch, the 3D trucking sim has continued to head in the right direction thanks to a macro-level approach that sees you rack up your miles on the spreadsheet rather than the road. ...
